audience: teams who send text messages to customers with BulkSMS

useCases.title: Check our credits, daily quota and sender ids
useCases.text: Shows the account's credit balance and limit, the daily message quota with what is left today, and the sender ids it may use.

useCases.title: Review sent and received messages and their status
useCases.text: Lists sent and received messages, newest first, from the last 7 days or from a date you give, and opens one for its body, status, parts and credit cost.

useCases.title: Check if anyone replied to a message
useCases.text: Lists the replies linked to a sent message. This works for messages sent with a repliable sender.

useCases.title: Check blocked numbers and webhooks
useCases.text: Lists the phone numbers the account may not send to, and the webhooks with their trigger and active flag.

useCases.title: Send a text message to up to 10 numbers
useCases.text: Sends one message text to 1 to 10 phone numbers in international format. It sends real messages that use credits.

useCases.title: Block a phone number
useCases.text: Adds one phone number to the account's blocked list, so no more messages are sent to it.
